# ResumeBench
**Type:** Measurement instrument  
**Supporting papers:** 1  

## State of the Field

A multilingual benchmark comprising 2,500 synthetic resumes across 50 templates and 5 languages, designed to evaluate LLMs on structured resume parsing with realism and privacy compliance.

## Sources

**ResumeBench** (1 paper: [Beyond Human Labels: A Multi-Linguistic Auto-Generated Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models on Resume Parsing](https://aclanthology.org/2025.emnlp-main.1626.pdf))
